* Tell compiler to support only A12 or later CPU, but I'm not sure this actually improves performance

## NOTE
* This version requires A12 or later device (iPhone XS/XR or later)
  * this is coming from GPU requirements (we need layered rendering)
* This version can install to iOS 14 or later device, but...
  * We only supports latest stable iOS.
  * in iOS 14.x or older, you can't use virtual controller (which means you need to use external controller, like DS4 or Xbox or MFi certificated controller)
* This version doesn't supporting these features:
  * Audio Input (Mic)
  * Camera
  * Motion Sensor
  * Touch Screen
  * NFC
  * SELECT/HOME button for physical controller
  * Circle Pad (including Pro), ZL/ZR, SELECT/START/HOME button for virtual controller

apps.name: CARROT Weather
apps.subtitle: The crazy-powerful weather app.
apps.localizedDescription:
Winter is coming, meatbags, but I've got an update for you that's approximately 756.3% less disappointing than the final season of Game of Thrones.

Redesigned Weather Alerts
Not only does my weather alerts screen show more information than ever before, many "warning"-level alerts will also show a map with the affected area highlighted so you can see if you're in the path of an oncoming severe thunderstorm, tornado, or hurricane. And if it's already too late for you to escape certain death, there may still be time to save your loved ones - just tap an alert to share it.

Secret Locations
You can quit pestering my Maker because there's not one but two brand new secret locations for you to track down. (This brings the grand total to 60!)

Alternate App Icon
Get in the holiday spirit with my festive new alternate app icon, "Now I Have A Machine Gun".

But wait, there's more!

- The Infograph “top text” complication is now available on California watch faces - just set the style to something other than "snark" to activate.
- Siri watch face cards now open directly to the Watch app when you tap on them.
- Snow accumulations for Dark Sky's day summaries are available again.

And because I ran out of coal, I also tossed in a bunch of bug fixes and performance improvements as stocking stuffers. Happy holidays, you filthy animals.

xoxo,
CARROT
